svg.data-weight-note: 50 lb (22.68 kg) without a FRU; 157.4 lb (71.4 kg) AC and 163.4 lb (74.11 kg) DC fully loaded (guide Table 5)
svg.data-depth-note: 30 in (76.2 cm) without the cable management brackets, air filter unit and handles; 36.5 in (92.7 cm) AC or 38.5 in (97.79 cm) DC with them
svg.data-width-note: 19 in (48.26 cm) with the brackets in the guide and the datasheet, 17.4 in (44.2 cm) in the specifications page; the body is modelled
svg.data-switching-capacity: up to 2.4 Tbps per slot, 4.8 Tbps maximum throughput (datasheet)
svg.data-port-density: up to 144 x 10 GbE with breakout cables, 36 x 40 GbE or 24 x 100 GbE at wire speed (datasheet, Table 4)
svg.data-line-cards: two slots; EX9253-6Q12C and EX9253-6Q12C-M, each 6 x QSFP+ and 12 x QSFP28 (not modelled)
svg.data-power-envelope-note: fully loaded switch, AC or DC; the datasheet's maximum power draw
svg.data-power-system-input-w: 2500 W AC and 2500 W DC system input power (guide Tables 9 and 11)
svg.data-power-input-ac: low line 90 to 140 VAC, high line 180 to 264 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 25 A system
svg.data-power-input-dc: operating -40 to -72 VDC, nominal -48 and -60 VDC; 54 A at -48 VDC system
svg.data-redundancy-note: up to six supplies; a base order is not redundant, a redundant order has four; two high-line or three low-line AC supplies for non-redundant operation
svg.data-thermal-output: 1705 BTU/hour (500 W) in the guide's Table 23; 13,600 BTU/hour (3840 W) in the datasheet
svg.data-fans: four fan trays, each with two counter-rotating fans, an air filter unit, and a fan in each supply
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing in operation; the datasheet gives 5 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 10,000 ft (3,048 m) with no performance degradation
svg.data-storage: two front-pluggable SSDs of up to 100 GB each (datasheet)
svg.data-redundancy: two Routing Engines, graceful Routing Engine switchover, nonstop active routing and nonstop bridging (datasheet)
svg.data-macsec: the EX9253-6Q12C-M line card, with the EX9253-SFL licence (datasheet)
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management Ethernet port (MGMT) on each Routing Engine, 10/100/1000
svg.data-console: RJ-45 serial console port (CON) on each Routing Engine
svg.data-usb: one USB port on each Routing Engine
svg.data-clock-and-time-io: BITS and ToD RJ-45, 10MHz and PPS SMB in and out, on each Routing Engine
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022, VCCI, BSMI CNS 13438, AS/NZS CISPR22 (datasheet)
svg.data-nebs: SR-3580 NEBS Criteria Level 3, GR-63-Core, GR-1089-Core (as the datasheet lists them)
